mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID, POSTER_URL, TITLE, MOVIE_RATING, TO_CHAR(OPEN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OPEN_DATE, OPEN_COUNTRY, RUNNING_TIME, INTRODUCE, SYNOPSIS, ORIGINAL_TITLE, STATE, "LANGUAGE", BUDGET, PROFIT FROM MOVIE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TMDB.MOVIE (MOVIE_ID, POSTER_URL, TITLE, MOVIE_RATING, OPEN_DATE, OPEN_COUNTRY, RUNNING_TIME, INTRODUCE, SYNOPSIS, ORIGINAL_TITLE, STATE, "LANGUAGE", BUDGET, PROFIT) VALUES(('MV-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_MOVIE_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0')), #{posterUrl}, #{title}, #{movieRating}, TO_DATE(#{openDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{openCountry}, 0, #{introduce}, #{synopsis}, #{originalTitle}, #{state}, #{language}, 0, 0)
